summary:
The Apollo 11 mission left some equipment after Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin left the Moon. Part of it is the Eagle Descent Stage, a part of the Lunar Module. Michael Collins stayed around the Moon controlling the equipment.
In this story, before this happened the three boys asked their Mum if they could go to the Moon, and she said yes.
details:
We first read about the Apollo 11 mission and watched this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oSUJIDKT8xc and other similar videos.

We talked to each other to decide what the story will be about.

We worked on Scratch Jr to create the animation but didn't have enough time to finish.

We want to do this again next year with more time!
